newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sell steady $65, slim-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle sell steady $65, slim-USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the panhandle area Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 500 Last Week - 5,100 Year Ago - None
Wk to date- 130,500 Last Week - 75,000 Year Ago - 54,700
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.50.

Sales were reported on 500 head slaughter heifers; 130,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 34,900 formulated and 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 2,400 head or 59 loads CME cattle deliveries.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
